craft_notes: Sthāyin: sight-honor (choicest forms). Rows: row 1 (form-parts whole — never trim a fused span). Close: praise. Rejected: splitting the fused span — killed: choicer-form-details-wind-quarter kept whole (span truth); 'sees' — killed: sight-bodied kept (dṛktan u as body, not act).

lines: With choicest form-parts, wind-quarter-seated in body, who
honors Bhairava — her Indrāṇī, sight-bodied, praise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: varatararūpaviśeṣairmārutadigdalaniṣaṇṇadehā yā | pūjayati bhairavaṃ tāmindrāṇīṃ dṛktanuṃ vande

reads_against.argmap: Who offers sight? → Indrāṇī (dṛk/sight, Vāyu petal) offers forms; choicer details are her flowers.
c1_essence: Indrāṇī sight-bodied honors with choicer forms from the northwest: seeing itself worship.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder circling home to rest)
